'''Landon Sommer Launching the EBO Assault''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Landon Sommer]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9036">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9036 Launching the EBO Assault], DeckTech (Landon "Periculum" Sommer, 2 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9036/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9036/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018142834/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9036/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Landon Sommer]]
* '''Published:''' 2 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Launching the EBO Assault''

== Original post ==

'''Launching the EBO Assault'''
* '''Author:''' Landon "Periculum" Sommer
* '''Published:''' August 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' I know that there are many EBOS out there but this one will take the cake. It capitalizes on all the new star cruiser oriented cards for massive drains and immunity.

=== Strategy ===

PLEASE READ Dont rate until you see what this is. Use any signals drawn to pull the important effects to hold in hand until use (EBO, LTA, SA, & Squad assignments are the most important.) if you lose any effects early on, go for honor of the jedi and use an effective repairs to pull back the effects. First turn pull two sites (before activate ALWAYS) and play them. Save any characters to drop all in one turn. Save the admirals orders until you need it. 2nd turn pull two more sites save force or draw to your liking 3rd turn pull ebo(if needed) and mon calamari system.Drop and play EBO if possible.same with the capital support. 4th start the setup. pull two more systems. Start dropping at mon calamri and moving out. use staging areas to become more versatile in deployment. 5th pull last systems. drop and drain. Battles should be no big deal this deck has plenty of power. Slow start but a power finish.

Playing vs the new objective, pull the endor system early (As soon as vader drops) and put luke there on a ship to satisfy your destiny. and use our only hope if you need to get cards back from insignificant rebellion.

This deck is not 100% please leave ideas with ratings. EBO and LTA are to give you drains of four and five at the systems. Have fun...
